rootRule: Lowest salted FEN SHA256 within each phase, unique validation family IDs, excluding all24 prior v1 profiling/timing roots. No teacher labels used. All roots disjoint from the fresh game bank because all primary-role families are quarantined there.
order: For replicate r rotate target+variant list left r*5 then reverse odd replicates; roots reverse on odd replicates; each root alternates baseline/candidate order by root ordinal plus replicate. Static order reverses on odd replicates. Entire complete grid is retained.
cpuPolicy: One measured process at a time pinned to the first available CPU; no concurrent builds, label generation or games. Record CPU affinity and quota/throttling metadata. Compilation, process startup, parsing and warmup excluded from search/evaluator timers.
exactness: Every full-model fixed-node signature must match across targets, variants and replicates: nodes,qnodes,depth,attempted_depth,score,move,stop_reason,cutoffs,researches,tt_saturated. HCE signatures checked separately. No timing or model is accepted on mismatch.
runtimeSelection: Choose the WASM target+variant with minimum geometric-mean full-candidate elapsed time over both budgets and all measured roots/replicates. Ties within0.5% prefer scalar then compact,fused,cached. Native winner is descriptive only. Original model remains fixed.

pruningCost.models: All validation-eligible recipes, including full, in original frozen recipe order
pruningCost.rootSubset: First12 selected roots in each phase, before replicate ordering
pruningCost.order: Eligible models start in frozen recipe order; rotate left by replicate, reverse odd replicates; roots and HCE/candidate order follow the full grid rule.
pruningCost.selection: At most one nonfull candidate: highest paired actual NPS ratio to full; ties within0.5% use lower validation CE then lexicographicID. All must first pass the frozen quality guards. No game outcomes used.

staticCacheInterpretation: Cached repeated-position benchmark is a warm-cache microbenchmark, not cold evaluator latency. Runtime/model selection uses complete search only.
publication: Freeze inputs, source snapshots, model bytes, native/modules and this configuration before observations; exclusive no-replace outputs and completion metadata last. Complete comparative screen exactly once; preserve failures and all configurations.
